questions.question: In indirect addressing mode, what does the address field of an instruction contain?
options: The effective address of the operand directly
The address of a memory location that stores the effective address
The address stored in the program counter
The register number containing the operand
questions.answer: The address of a memory location that stores the effective address

Which of the following statements regarding mutual exclusion in operating systems is false?
options: No two processes can execute in their critical sections simultaneously.
Multiple processes can safely access a shared critical resource simultaneously without synchronization.

Only one process is allowed to access a critical resource at a time.
questions.answer: Multiple processes can safely access a shared critical resource simultaneously without synchronization.
